第1570章 第一战体宇文元天1（第1页）
第一战体修为的确是可怕，竟然将杨凡都给压制住了，此人的名字叫做宇文元天，一身神通通玄，战力无可匹敌。
他出手确实凌厉至极，第一次出手就让杨凡吃了不小的亏。
此人对战机的把握也是极其到位的，根本不给杨凡过多反应的时间，便再次杀来了，展开了第二波攻势。
“轰”。第二拳杀来，山呼海啸一般的攻势，威猛霸道，惊人至极。
这第一战体的强大的确出乎了杨凡的意料。
不过，他虽然强大，但还没有强大到秒杀自己的程度。
杨凡深吸一口气，化出了大玄武术与大防御术两种三千大道，攻击之前先将防御做好，这才是上上之策。
接着，杨凡施展出来了不灭战体家族传承的成仙之法。
道图凝聚而成，三十五种三千大道凝聚在一起威力相当可怕，天地之间传递出来了敲大法螺，撞击长生钟的声音，而后天地巨震，神音袅袅，一阵阵凶猛的波动传递而出，席卷天地，道图横空碾压向了第一战体宇文元天。
“我不灭战体家族的成仙道图，你果然会这一招，你到底是怎么学会的？”。宇文元天的脸色顿时一沉，杨凡竟然懂得他们不灭战体家族最大的秘密，这让他相当不爽，他眼神阴沉，一拳轰杀而来，他也修炼了这招神通，但是并没有施展出来，他施展的乃是一招叫做“荒古神拳”的强大神通，一股古老苍茫的气息从他的身体之中传递而出，那一拳的威力简直可以称之为毁天灭地，狠狠轰杀在道图之上，杨凡凝聚的道图竟然传出来了咔嚓咔嚓的声音，显然是龟裂掉了。
这道图本身缺失了最为核心的道，再加上宇文元天也修炼过这神通，最为主要的是宇文元天修炼的乃是完整神通，对于这道图有什么弱点他一清二楚，所以一招将杨凡的这招神通给破解掉了，他冷笑出声“呵，我还以为你真的掌握了我族的成仙之法，原来最为核心的部分没有掌握，缺少最为核心的那一部分，你这神通便什么都不算”。
杨凡冷笑，他用这招神通也并非是想要击伤此人，这只是虚晃一招而已。
真正的杀招杨凡现在才开始施展出来，若说修为的话杨凡不是这第一战体宇文元天的对手，但若说战斗经验谁能比得上杨凡？
从十三岁开始，杨凡便一次次从死人堆里爬出来，他的战斗经验之丰富不比任何一个老妖怪差，在宇文元天破掉成仙道图的时候杨凡已经施展出来了太阳太阴之法，凝聚阴阳道图，朝着宇文元天劈杀而去。
阴阳道图斩碎了虚空，横扫诸天，碎裂苍穹，一击之威，天抖地颤，狠狠朝着宇文元天的头颅斩杀而去。
“找死”。宇文元天的眼神阴沉无比，怒喝一声，双手朝着道图轰杀而来。
他这招神通也是相当强悍，竟然以双手撼动阴阳道图，此人的确是相当的变态。

一声声的震天巨响传递而出，双方一次又一次的碰撞在了一起，这种碰撞是相当惊人的，也是相当可怕的，每一次碰撞都堪称惊天动地一般，让人吃惊与动容，杨凡身化阴阳图轰杀宇文元天，而此人只是以双手硬撼，由此可知此人的修为到底多么的恐怖吧，真是变态啊，这种战力怕是要逆天的。

Chapter 1570 The First Battle Body Yuwen Yuantian 1 (Page 1)
The cultivation level of the first combat body is indeed terrifying, and it actually suppressed Yang Fan. This person's name is Yuwen Yuantian, he has magical powers and mystical powers, and his combat power is unrivaled.
His attacks were indeed extremely sharp, and Yang Fan suffered a big loss with his first attack.
This person also had an extremely good grasp of the fighter plane. He didn't give Yang Fan much time to react before he came again and launched a second wave of offensive.
"boom". The second punch came, and the attack was like a roaring mountain and a tsunami. It was so powerful and overbearing that it was extremely shocking.
The power of this first combat body was indeed beyond Yang Fan's expectation.
However, although he is powerful, he is not powerful enough to kill himself instantly.
Yang Fan took a deep breath and formed two kinds of three thousand avenues, the Great Mysterious Martial Arts and the Great Defense Technique. The best strategy is to prepare the defense well before attacking.
Then, Yang Fan used the immortality method inherited from the Immortal War Body family.
The Dao Diagram was condensed. Thirty-five kinds of three thousand Dao Dao were condensed together, and the power was quite terrifying. The sound of knocking the conch and hitting the longevity bell was transmitted between the heaven and the earth. Then the heaven and earth shook violently, divine sounds curled up, and ferocious fluctuations were transmitted out, sweeping the world. The Dao Diagram rolled across the sky and crushed Yuwen Yuantian, the first combat body.
"You really know how to become an immortal in my Immortal War Body family's diagram. How did you learn it?" Yuwen Yuantian's face suddenly darkened. Yang Fan actually knew the biggest secret of their Immortal War Body family, which made him quite unhappy. His eyes were gloomy, and he came with a punch. He also practiced this magical power, but he did not use it. What he used was a move called "Ancient Ancient". With the powerful magical power of "Divine Fist", an ancient and vast aura was transmitted from his body. The power of that punch could be called the destruction of the heaven and the earth. It hit the Dao Diagram fiercely. The Dao Diagram condensed by Yang Fan actually made a cracking sound, and it was obviously cracked.
This diagram itself lacks the core of the Dao. In addition, Yuwen Yuantian has also practiced this magical power. The most important thing is that Yuwen Yuantian has practiced complete magical powers. He knows all about the weaknesses of this diagram, so he can kill Yang Fan with one move. This magical power was broken, and he sneered, "Oh, I thought you really mastered the method of becoming an immortal in our clan. It turns out that you have not mastered the most core part. Without the most core part, your magical power is nothing."
Yang Fan sneered, he didn't use this magical power to hurt this person, it was just a feint.
Yang Fan has just begun to display the real killing move now. In terms of cultivation, Yang Fan is not the opponent of the first combat body Yuwen Yuantian, but in terms of combat experience, who can compare to Yang Fan?
Since he was thirteen years old, Yang Fan has crawled out of the dead again and again. His fighting experience is as rich as any old monster. When Yuwen Yuantian destroyed the Immortal Path Diagram, Yang Fan had already used the Sun and Taiyin method to condense the Yin and Yang Dao Diagram and attack Yuwen Yuantian.
The Yin-Yang Dao Diagram shattered the void, swept across the heavens, shattered the sky, and with the power of one blow, the sky trembled and the earth trembled, and it mercilessly beheaded Yuwen Yuantian's head.
"court death". Yuwen Yuantian's eyes were extremely gloomy, he shouted angrily, and shot towards Dao Tu with both hands.
His magical power is also quite powerful, and he can actually shake the Yin-Yang Dao Diagram with his hands. This person is indeed quite a pervert.
Loud noises were heard, and the two sides collided again and again. This collision was quite astonishing and terrifying. Every collision was earth-shattering, surprising and moving. Yang Fan transformed into a Yin-Yang figure to kill Yuwen.Yuan Tian, ​​and this person only shook it with his hands. From this, we can see how terrifying this person's cultivation is. He is really abnormal. This kind of fighting power is probably going to defy the heavens.
